assertions.name: K4_ppnn_lambda_ss_equals_sqrt5
assertions.unit: ss-sector eigenvalue of the K4(ppnn) writhe matrix
assertions.source: Route A: mp.eigsy spectrum of S_4(ppnn) = {-sqrt5,-1,+1,+sqrt5}. Route B: sqrt(5) = sqrt(1+2^2), the +-sqrt5 species-symmetric writhe modes recorded in PR #4084 FACT 1 at undeformed pn-degree 2.

assertions.name: ss_pole_from_determinant_equals_inverse_lambda_ss
assertions.unit: per-bond magnitude g at the A=4 ss-sector pole
assertions.source: Route A: bisection for the smallest positive root of det(I + g*S_4) = 0 -- determinant only. Route B: 1/lambda_ss from the mp.eigsy spectrum -- eigenvalue only. The probe's det-based AT_POLE classifier and its g*lambda_ss criticality column are only the same statement if these coincide.

description: alpha-magic as criticality: the species-symmetric exchange criticality g_reeb*lambda_ss(A) rises monotonically across the He4-local domain and hits the ss-condensation pole EXACTLY at 4He (the [1^4] closed shell, C(4,4)=1), with A<=3 sub-critical and A>=5 off-domain (C(4,A)=0). Forward, g_reeb fixed from q0, no fit. Explains WHICH isotope is critical and WHY alpha is magic; the finite 4He magnitude (pole regulator = Vol*rho) stays open. Connects the b4 ss-pole (PR #4084) to the corpus non-constant inter-cluster volume (2026-07-13). Audit-only.
caveats: Eigensolver changed from mp.eig to mp.eigsy in this run (2026-08-30). S is real symmetric by construction, so eigsy is the correct routine; mp.eig raised 'qr: failed to converge after 281 steps' on the 6x6 6Li word at compute_dps=70 under mpmath 1.3.0 AND 1.4.1, which made the probe unrunnable. Value-identical: every lambda_ss here reproduces the 2026-07-19 witness exactly.
tier: structural (fixed g_reeb + pure graph eigenvalues; no fit, no AME inversion)

reading.alpha_magic: 4He is the UNIQUE light isotope on the species-symmetric condensation pole at the derived g_reeb ([1^4] closed shell, C(4,4)=1). g_reeb*lambda_ss rises monotonically 2H<3H<4He and hits the pole (=1; exactly 1 under consistent deformation) only at A=4 -- the structural origin of alpha-magic (rho4>>pair-additive).
reading.off_domain: A>=5 have C(4,A)=0 (no [1^4] channel); det<0 is the single-scalar b4 correctly signalling the He4-local term is ABSENT, not a spurious prediction. Model breakdown past A=4 = He4-locality.
reading.inter_cluster_link: the corpus's non-constant implied per-bond volume (2.9->12.8, 2026-07-13) and the refuted single-link Vol4 are what a near-pole enhancement looks like: the near-critical ss-mode's moduli volume grows toward the pole; 4He (AT the pole) has the largest/formally-divergent enhancement.
reading.still_open: the FINITE 4He magnitude = the pole regulator / collective-coordinate moduli volume (Vol*rho), open (PR #4084). This probe fixes WHICH isotope is critical and WHY alpha is magic; it does not close the magnitude.

result.verdict: scope-(a) forward structural result: alpha-magic = A=4 ss-condensation criticality; g_reeb fixed from q0, lambda_ss(A) pure graph eigenvalues, no fit. Sharpens the open regulator target to a critical-point moduli volume.
